On-Chain Operator. Lesson 11.3, Liquidation protection: buffers, alerts and automated deleveraging. Navy and cyan. One idea at a time. You write it down. Education only.
You already know a health factor and a stop. A hedge is another written path. It is not a claim that the risk is gone.

Three layers: buffer (HF ≥ 2–2.5 at entry) → alerts (HF 2.0 and 1.7, Module 14.1) → action (repay, add collateral, or automated deleveraging tools that repay debt when HF crosses a trigger; these add their own contract and permission risk).
Pre-compute the repayment needed to restore your target HF: debt to keep = collateral value × LT ÷ target HF.
Work the example on paper. 10 ETH falls to $2,400 → collateral $24,000, LT 0.8, debt $12,000 → HF 1.6. Stamp it Example. It is not a level to copy onto a live position.
Work the example on paper. To restore HF 2.5: debt must be 24,000 × 0.8 ÷ 2.5 = $7,680 → repay $4,320 from the reserve. Stamp it Example. It is not a level to copy onto a live position.
On the checklist, this line has to be true in writing: Alerts at HF 2.0 and 1.7. If you cannot write it, the line is open.
On the checklist, this line has to be true in writing: Repayment to restore target HF pre-computed. If you cannot write it, the line is open.
On the checklist, this line has to be true in writing: Reserve covers that repayment. If you cannot write it, the line is open.
Check yourself. 1. Collateral $40,000, LT 0.8, target HF 2. Max debt? The answer: $16,000.
Check yourself. 2. What do automated deleveraging tools add? The answer: Their own contract and permission risk.
Check yourself. 3. Why pre-compute the repayment? The answer: So you act immediately, not while calculating under stress.
By the end of this lesson, you'll be able to make liquidation practically impossible with buffers, alerts and pre-computed repayment.

Three layers: buffer (health factor at least 2 to 2.5 at entry) to alerts (health factor 2.0 and 1.7, Module 14.1) to action (repay, add collateral, or automated deleveraging tools that repay debt when health factor crosses a trigger; these add their own contract and permission risk).
Pre-compute the repayment needed to restore your target health factor: debt to keep equals collateral value times LT divided by target health factor.

To restore health factor 2.5: debt must be 24,000 times 0.8 divided by 2.5 = $7,680 to repay $4,320 from the reserve.
First, Alerts at health factor 2.0 and 1.7.
Next, Repayment to restore target health factor pre-computed.
